title: SelfIncorporationService: skeleton + kernel wiring
body:
**Background**: Introduce a kernel-managed service that orchestrates discovery→classify→gate→plan→integrate. Hooks into Service Registry and runs on boot.

**Tasks**
- Create `SelfIncorporationService` class (start/stop, status, metrics)
- Register with Service Registry + heartbeats
- Add kernel task types (`self_incorporation.start`, `self_incorporation.tick`)
- Expose `GET /api/selfinc/status`

**Definition of Done**
- Service starts during launcher Phase 2–3 and reports **HEALTHY**
- Status endpoint returns counts (found/classified/planned/applied/quarantined)

title: Code Index: SQLite + JSONL mirror
body:
**Background**: Persist discovered files with hashes/mtimes/types for deterministic planning.

**Tasks**
- Schema: `file_items` (id/hash/path/size/mtime/type/lang/entrypoints json)
- Writer with dedupe by content hash
- JSONL mirror for quick diffs
- CLI: `aether selfinc scan --preview`

**Definition of Done**
- Scan of repo root produces deterministic index; re-scan updates deltas

title: Discovery walker (roots, ignores, limits)
body:
**Tasks**
- Walk roots from policy/env (`AETHERRA_SELFINC_ROOTS`)
- Respect `.aetherraignore`, size/type filters
- Emit discovery progress events for UI

**Definition of Done**
- Handles large trees without blocking kernel main loop (background queue)

title: Heuristic classifier (plugin/agent/.aether/workflow/utility/docs)
body:
**Background**: Lightweight classifiers by filename, manifests, headers, AST.

**Tasks**
- Plugin detector (manifest schema)
- Agent detector (`handle_task`, `capabilities`)
- `.aether` header parse (`meta/policy/require`)
- Workflow/docs/utility heuristics

**Definition of Done**
- ≥95% correct classification on repo sample set

title: Safety Gate: signatures + static scans + capability policy
body:
**Background**: Verify `.aether` (HMAC) & plugin manifests (ed25519), static risk, capability allowlists.

**Tasks**
- Hook `.aether` HMAC verify
- Plugin manifest ed25519 verify (strict optional)
- Static risk & secret scans
- Capability check against `~/.aetherra/policy/capabilities.json`
- Compute trust tier: verified/trusted/standard/experimental/quarantined

**Definition of Done**
- Fails closed in strict mode; audit record written on deny

title: Integration Planner: dep graph + action mapping
body:
**Tasks**
- Build dep graph from `requires`/imports
- Toposort with risk bias
- Map to actions: register_plugin/agent/script, expose_tool, sandbox, quarantine

**Definition of Done**
- Plans are deterministic given index + policy snapshot

title: Integrator: Plugins/Agents/.aether/Utilities
body:
**Background**: Register components with Plugin Manager, Agent Orchestrator, and `.aether` runtime.

**Tasks**
- Plugin registration (concurrency caps, timeouts)
- Agent registration (health probes)
- `.aether` script indexing/compile cache
- Utility wrapping as tools (purity/idempotency metadata)

**Definition of Done**
- All integrations logged; failures produce remediation hints

title: Ethics & Audit logging (append-only)
body:
**Background**: Every apply/deny includes ethics profile snapshot + reasons.

**Tasks**
- JSONL ledger with rotation
- Link to scans, signatures, capabilities
- CLI query: `aether selfinc audit --recent`

**Definition of Done**
- Ledger entries created for 100% of decisions

title: Kernel/Hub status + minimal metrics
body:
**Tasks**
- `/api/selfinc/status` & Prometheus counters: found/classified/planned/applied/quarantined
- Add to `/metrics` and site status for UI

**Definition of Done**
- Grafana panel shows first successful run with non-zero counts

title: Acceptance tests (Phase 1)
body:
**Tasks**
- Cold boot: integrates known components; zero quarantines (non-strict)
- Unsigned plugin (strict) → quarantined
- Capability escalation → denied + audit

**Definition of Done**
- All pass in CI

title: HMR integration (quiesce/swap/rollback)
body:
**Background**: Use kernel HMR for safe on-the-fly swaps; audit attempts/rollbacks.

**Tasks**
- Quiesce targets; swap; verify; auto-rollback on failure
- HMR metrics: attempts/success/rollback per target

**Definition of Done**
- Simulated post-swap failure rolls back automatically

title: Night-cycle deep checks & optimization
body:
**Background**: Run heavy scans/evals between 02:00–04:00 local.

**Tasks**
- Re-score risks, expand tests
- Consolidate memory links to integrated items
- Ethics review delta report

**Definition of Done**
- Nightly report artifact stored + exposed in UI

title: Quarantine workflow + remediation suggestions
body:
**Tasks**
- Queue quarantined items with reasons
- Auto-suggest: sign, reduce capabilities, sandbox profile
- `/api/selfinc/apply` supports “promote from quarantine”

**Definition of Done**
- 2/3 common failure modes recoverable via suggestions

title: Ethics & Audit dashboard widgets
body:
**Tasks**
- Add UI cards: ethics deltas, capability denials, recent decisions
- Prometheus: `aetherra_selfinc_policy_denied_total{reason}`

**Definition of Done**
- Live widgets visible in Lyrixa panel / Hub UI

title: Control APIs: scan/apply/rollback/audit
body:
**Tasks**
- `POST /api/selfinc/scan` (path filter)
- `POST /api/selfinc/apply` (subset of plan actions)
- `POST /api/selfinc/rollback` (rb_token)
- `GET /api/selfinc/audit?query=...`

**Definition of Done**
- All endpoints token-guarded per Hub policy

title: Expanded metrics & alerts
body:
**Tasks**
- Histograms: duration; HMR rollbacks; quarantine by risk
- Alerts: spike in denials/quarantines

**Definition of Done**
- Alert fires on synthetic failure burst

title: Learning classifier (feedback-tuned)
body:
**Tasks**
- Collect ground truth from operator overrides
- Incremental model to improve classification precision

**Definition of Done**
- +3–5% precision over heuristics on validation set

title: Dependency graph visualizer
body:
**Tasks**
- Build graph from index + imports
- UI viz: nodes by type; edges by require/import

**Definition of Done**
- Interactive in Lyrixa panel (filter by type/trust)

title: Spec→Tests Gate integration (Coding System)
body:
**Background**: Enforce “tests before activation” for runtime-affecting changes.

**Tasks**
- Hook gate into Integrator pipeline
- Fail activation if missing tests (configurable)

**Definition of Done**
- Red tests allowed; but tests must exist; audit records updated
